tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Start here to build a website. Returns templates, industries, style presets and a complete starter document to fill in.

tools.name: start_onboarding
tools.description: Create the user's website. Saves the document as a private draft and returns an approvalUrl; give that link to the user, who signs in with this email and approves to publish. No account or email verification is needed on your side, and no email is sent.

tools.name: onboarding_status
tools.description: Read onboarding status using the private continuation credential.

tools.name: exchange_onboarding
tools.description: After owner approval, exchange the private continuation credential for an API token. Keep returned credentials private.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Read the owner’s site and current revision. State is draft or live.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create one structured draft. Does not publish. Fails if the owner already has a site.

tools.name: save_site
tools.description: Replace the draft using the current revision. Does not change the live publication.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List retained uploaded images owned by this site.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (5 MiB maximum). Returns an assetId for the document.

tools.name: preview_site
tools.description: Return private draft preview HTML, with enquiry submission disabled.

tools.name: publication_status
tools.description: Read publication state and published revision.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish the saved revision to a public hosted address. Requires sites:publish.

tools.name: unpublish_site
tools.description: Remove the current public publication. Draft and enquiries are retained.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "exchange_onboarding" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: After owner approval, exchange the private continuation credential for an API token. Keep returned credentials private.
